answer: Paired-bond attestation: a beacon shuffles all identities into cross-pairs each epoch, and a pair counts only when both co-sign one work record at an assigned wharf slot. Liability is joint: if either output fails audit, both bonds burn against the larger umber collateral the pair must post. Partners come from the whole pool, so a clone cannot pick its sibling; every extra clone endangers an honest bond and must lock fresh umber stake it cannot pool. Draws repeat across the tundra, so attacker cost grows quadratically while a solo agent still pairs once.
